experiments.name: VEVO SK product CTA color
experiments.hypothesis: Changing only the product-detail add-to-cart CTA background from the current control color to one approved, accessible, high-contrast VEVO brand color will increase the share of exposed product viewers who add a product to cart because the primary action is easier to notice.
experiments.population: Eligible consented devices on Slovak product-detail pages where the add-to-cart CTA is actually rendered.
experiments.allowed_change: Only the approved CTA background gradient and text color; label, dimensions, layout, placement, selectors, prices, cart, checkout, and every other element remain unchanged.
